import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 10))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))

# 1. Fraud distribution by transaction type
fraud_by_type = df.groupby('transaction_type')['is_fraud'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars1 = axes[0, 0].bar(fraud_by_type.index, fraud_by_type.values * 100, color=['#ff6b6b', '#4ecdc4', '#45b7d1'])
axes[0, 0].set_title('Fraud Rate by Transaction Type', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Fraud Rate (%)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
for bar in bars1:
    height = bar.get_height()
    axes[0, 0].text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.5,
                   f'{height:.1f}%', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

# 2. Transaction amount distribution by fraud status
fraud_amounts = df[df['is_fraud'] == 1]['amount']
legit_amounts = df[df['is_fraud'] == 0]['amount']
bins = np.linspace(0, max(df['amount']), 30)
axes[0, 1].hist(legit_amounts, bins=bins, alpha=0.7, label='Legitimate', color='#4ecdc4', edgecolor='black')
axes[0, 1].hist(fraud_amounts, bins=bins, alpha=0.7, label='Fraud', color='#ff6b6b', edgecolor='black')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Transaction Amount Distribution by Fraud Status', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].legend()

# 3. Fraud distribution by hour of day
fraud_by_hour = df.groupby('hour_of_day')['is_fraud'].mean()
axes[1, 0].plot(fraud_by_hour.index, fraud_by_hour.values * 100, marker='o', linewidth=2, color='#ff6b6b')
axes[1, 0].fill_between(fraud_by_hour.index, 0, fraud_by_hour.values * 100, alpha=0.2, color='#ff6b6b')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Fraud Rate by Hour of Day', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Fraud Rate (%)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_xticks(range(0, 24, 3))
axes[1, 0].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 4. Transaction type distribution with fraud overlay
type_counts = df['transaction_type'].value_counts()
fraud_counts = df[df['is_fraud'] == 1]['transaction_type'].value_counts()
x = np.arange(len(type_counts))
width = 0.35
bars1 = axes[1, 1].bar(x - width/2, type_counts.values, width, label='All Transactions', color='#4ecdc4', edgecolor='black')
bars2 = axes[1, 1].bar(x + width/2, [fraud_counts.get(type, 0) for type in type_counts.index], 
                       width, label='Fraud Transactions', color='#ff6b6b', edgecolor='black')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Transaction Volume vs Fraud Count by Type', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_xticks(x)
axes[1, 1].set_xticklabels(type_counts.index)
axes[1, 1].legend()

# Add overall title
plt.suptitle('Credit Card Fraud Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Adjust layout and save
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.close()
